csv.float64: shortest round-trip decimal (Python repr); NaN/Infinity forbidden

columns.name: solver
columns.description: Native solver: '8' (Cao/Sol8), '5' (Chen-style/Sol5), 'LP' (Imanishi-Iwata-style/HalfIntBranching).

columns.name: graph_id
columns.description: PACE 2016 public graph ID, e.g. '001'. Future grouping key: keep all rows of a graph together, across solvers.

columns.name: state_id
columns.description: Stage C event ID of the saved state (<instrumented run id>:<sequence>).

columns.name: state_index
columns.description: Ordinal of the state in the pinned Stage D index (0-based).

columns.name: candidate_local_id
columns.description: Local vertex ID of the eligible candidate in the snapshot.

columns.name: candidate_label
columns.description: stageNames label (original input vertex label) of the candidate.

columns.name: candidate_ordinal
columns.description: Position of the candidate in the validated eligible list (0-based). Not a model input.

columns.name: original_local_id
columns.description: Local ID of the pivot chosen by the original policy at this state.

columns.name: is_original_pivot
columns.description: Candidate equals the original pivot. Not a model input.

columns.name: root_local_id
columns.description: LP only: saved solve2 root (active SAFE vertex); null for 8 and 5.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: Stage C decision phase (cao_max_degree, chen_fallback, lp_neighbor).

columns.name: component_subsolver
columns.description: Decision occurred inside a connected-component subsolver (isSub).

columns.name: depth
columns.description: Stage C recursive search-frame depth (root call = 0). Metadata only.

columns.name: solver_depth
columns.description: Upstream BranchingSolution::depth at the decision. Metadata only.

columns.name: sample_kind
columns.description: Stage C sample kind: 'first_A' or 'reservoir'.

columns.name: sample_slot
columns.description: Reservoir slot (-1 for first_A).

columns.name: sample_sequence
columns.description: Decision sequence number within the Stage C instrumented run.

columns.name: sample_a_index
columns.description: Index of this A event among the run's A events (1 = first).

columns.name: snapshot_bytes
columns.description: Length of the STAGEC1 snapshot in bytes.

columns.name: state_metadata_ref
columns.description: Reference to the parent state's record: 'states.jsonl#<state_id>'.

columns.name: stage_c_run_id
columns.description: Stage C workflow run of record.

columns.name: stage_d_run_id
columns.description: Stage D workflow run of record.

columns.name: snapshot_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the snapshot bytes (verified against the index).

columns.name: candidate_list_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the little-endian int32 candidate list bytes (verified).

columns.name: packed_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the samples.bin.zz stream containing the state (verified).

columns.name: snapshot_source_path
columns.description: samples.json path (relative to the Stage C records commit) the state was sliced from.

columns.name: sample_offset
columns.description: Byte offset of the snapshot in the decompressed samples.bin stream.

columns.name: candidates_offset
columns.description: Byte offset of the candidate list in the decompressed stream.

columns.name: f_cand_none_neighbors
columns.description: |D(v)|: distinct active neighbours of v with status 0.

columns.name: f_cand_safe_neighbors
columns.description: |U(v)|: distinct active neighbours of v with status 1.

columns.name: f_cand_double_edges
columns.description: Number of distinct active neighbours u of v whose edge {v,u} is flagged double.

columns.name: f_nbr_none_wdeg_min
columns.description: min over u in D(v) of w(u) = |N(u)| + double edges of u; 0.0 if D(v) is empty.

columns.name: f_nbr_none_wdeg_mean
columns.description: sum over u in D(v) of w(u) (integer) / |D(v)| (float64); 0.0 if D(v) is empty.

columns.name: f_nbr_none_wdeg_max
columns.description: max over u in D(v) of w(u); 0.0 if D(v) is empty.

columns.name: f_state_none_vertices
columns.description: Active vertices with status 0 (isolated ones included).

columns.name: f_state_safe_vertices
columns.description: Active vertices with status 1 (isolated ones included).

columns.name: f_state_distinct_edges
columns.description: Unordered active pairs {u,w} that are adjacent, each counted once regardless of multiplicity.

columns.name: f_state_double_edges
columns.description: Unordered active adjacent pairs whose edge is flagged double.

columns.name: f_state_remaining_threshold
columns.description: snapshot.size_cap - len(snapshot.X); size_cap is the strict improvement cutoff, so an improving solution may delete threshold-1 more vertices. Not clamped.

columns.name: f_state_candidate_count
columns.description: Length of the validated eligible-candidate list.

columns.name: f_lp_root_common_neighbors
columns.description: LP only: |N(v) intersect N(r)| over distinct active vertices (r = saved root); null for 8 and 5.

columns.name: diag_allocated_N
columns.description: Allocated vertex slots N in the snapshot (NOT the active size).

columns.name: diag_stored_M
columns.description: Stored M field (NOT a trustworthy residual edge count).

columns.name: diag_current_X_size
columns.description: len(snapshot.X) at the decision.

columns.name: diag_initial_size_cap
columns.description: Snapshot size_cap (strict improvement cutoff) at the decision.

columns.name: diag_initial_solFound
columns.description: Snapshot solFound at the decision.

columns.name: diag_cand_distinct_degree
columns.description: f_cand_none_neighbors + f_cand_safe_neighbors.

columns.name: diag_cand_weighted_degree
columns.description: diag_cand_distinct_degree + f_cand_double_edges (equals the upstream degWithDouble).

columns.name: classical_score_json
columns.description: Original selector score: Cao/LP weighted degree; Chen [edges into U, weighted degree]. Metadata only.

columns.name: classical_rank
columns.description: 1 + number of candidates with a strictly greater classical score. Metadata only.

columns.name: invocation_count
columns.description: Number of Stage D records found for this candidate key in the pinned run.

columns.name: invocation_resolution
columns.description: 'unique', 'missing' or 'multiple'. With 'multiple' no attempt is chosen and scalar outcome fields are null.

columns.name: invocation_refs_json
columns.description: All records for this key: [{run_id, chunk_id, attempt_id, source_record_path, source_record_line}].

columns.name: invocation_run_id
columns.description: Stage D arm UUID. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: chunk_id
columns.description: Stage D chunk directory name. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: attempt_id
columns.description: Chunk attempt directory name. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: source_record_path
columns.description: records.jsonl path relative to the Stage D results commit. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: source_record_line
columns.description: 1-based line of the record in records.jsonl. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: source_record_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of that records.jsonl file. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: experiment_commit
columns.description: Stage D experiment commit recorded by the arm. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: executable_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the Stage D executable. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: source_hashes_sha256
columns.description: Canonical-JSON SHA-256 of the arm's source_hashes map (full map in invocations.jsonl). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: environment_build_group
columns.description: Canonical-JSON SHA-256 of {cpu, image, executable_sha256}; null if any part is missing. Comparability key, not a feature. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique.

columns.name: raw_status
columns.description: Record status as written (completed, cpu_timeout, external_stop, ...). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: counts_source
columns.description: Record counts_source ('final' can still describe a censored prefix). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: exit_code
columns.description: Process exit code. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: forced_termination
columns.description: True if the driver force-killed the arm; null when the record does not specify it. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: original_reproduction
columns.description: Recorded original-pivot reproduction verdict. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: original_reproduction_recheck
columns.description: Recheck from archived Stage C digests: pass / FAIL / untested / not_original (no solver run). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: environment_cpu
columns.description: Runner CPU model string. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: environment_image
columns.description: Runner image string. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: environment_os
columns.description: Runner OS string (provenance). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: environment_runner
columns.description: Runner name (provenance; not a compatibility key). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: cpu_budget_s
columns.description: Process-CPU budget of the arm (seconds). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: observed_nodes
columns.description: measurement.total_nodes (recursive search-node entries in both children), when a valid integer >= 0. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: exact_nodes
columns.description: observed_nodes only for a unique, valid, completed, reconciled, non-forced, join-valid arm; null otherwise (including every censored arm). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: observed_branching_decisions
columns.description: measurement.branching_decisions (parent decision + child decisions). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: node_observation_kind
columns.description: exact | prefix | missing | invalid | unresolved_multiple. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: measurement_status
columns.description: measurement.status. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: nodes_reconcile
columns.description: Recorded nodes_reconcile flag. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: branches_reconcile
columns.description: Recorded branches_reconcile flag. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: final_size_cap
columns.description: Final incumbent size_cap after the continuation (not a proven graph optimum). Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: final_solFound
columns.description: Final incumbent solFound. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: process_cpu_s
columns.description: record.cpu_s: whole-process CPU seconds (GetProcessTimes). 0.0 is a timer reading, not proof of zero work. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: process_wall_s
columns.description: record.wall_s: process lifetime seconds. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: driver_wall_s
columns.description: record.driver_wall_s: driver-measured wall seconds. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: setup_cpu_s
columns.description: measurement.setup_cpu_s. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: continuation_cpu_s
columns.description: measurement.continuation_cpu_s. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: continuation_wall_s
columns.description: measurement.continuation_wall_s. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: parent_overhead_cpu_s
columns.description: measurement.parent_overhead_cpu_s. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: parent_overhead_wall_s
columns.description: measurement.parent_overhead_wall_s. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: finalization_cpu_s
columns.description: record.finalization_cpu_s as recorded. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: peak_memory_bytes
columns.description: record.peak_memory_bytes. Null unless invocation_resolution is unique and the value is present and valid.

columns.name: join_valid
columns.description: Unique record agrees with the index on every join key and immutable input; null when no unique record.

columns.name: state_integrity_ok
columns.description: Parent state passed every hash, decode, eligibility and active-adjacency check.

columns.name: measurement_integrity_ok
columns.description: Unique record passed all measurement consistency checks; null when no unique record.

columns.name: state_completed_cap_consistent
columns.description: All unique completed arms of the state report the same final size_cap; null when the state has no unique completed arm.

columns.name: validation_errors_json
columns.description: List of row-level validation error strings (state, join and measurement); [] when none.

allowlist_note: Initial v1 input allowlists. LP excludes f_cand_safe_neighbors and f_state_safe_vertices (stored for audit: every saved LP state has exactly one SAFE vertex, the root, and every candidate neighbours it). Choosing training feature blocks is a separate, later decision.
